QUOTE: "The formula is `(tier1 or tier2 or tier5) ∪ tier3 ∪ tier4`. A flag or declaration replaces the whole list, not individual entries. Tiers 3 and 4 survive any stated tier, so `main` in entry patterns cannot be dropped by a flag."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says stated tiers replace each other while the discovered tiers 3 and 4 accumulate and survive any stated tier.
